title: Hear God's Voice: 5 Biblical Signals
script: Hear God—without overthinking—5 signs. One: It matches Scripture; God never contradicts His Word (2 Timothy 3:16). Two: It grows Christlike fruit—love, joy, peace, patience (Galatians 5:22-23). Three: It gives a steady peace, not frantic pressure; let Christ’s peace rule (Colossians 3:15). Four: It’s affirmed by wise, godly counsel (Proverbs 11:14). Five: Providence nudges through opened and closed doors (Acts 16:6-10). Quick bias check: name the fear, then test the thought by Scripture and fruit. Prayer: Jesus, lead my steps and quiet my spin. This week, journal confirmations and patterns each day.

title: Stop Second-Guessing: Simple Filters to Hear God
hook: If God feels silent right now, watch this.
script: If God feels silent right now, watch this. You’re not broken—you need better filters. Jesus said, My sheep hear My voice (John 10:27). Ask: Does this align with Scripture, not just vibes? (2 Timothy 3:16). Does it move me toward love and self-control? (Galatians 5:22-23). Do I sense peace ruling, not panic pushing? (Colossians 3:15). Have mature believers confirmed it? (Proverbs 11:14). Are doors opening or closing providentially, like Paul in Acts 16? Quick bias check: say the fear out loud, then submit the thought to the Word. Pray, Speak Lord. Then journal confirmations for seven days.

title: From Spiral to Clarity: 5 Signs It’s God
script: You may be overthinking this. I used to analyze every nudge until I learned five steady signals. God’s voice won’t clash with Scripture; that’s your anchor (2 Timothy 3:16). It produces Jesus-shaped fruit, not ego spikes (Galatians 5:22-23). Peace becomes the umpire, not pressure (Colossians 3:15). Wise counsel echoes it back (Proverbs 11:14). And patterns in providence guide your steps, like Acts 16’s red lights and green lights. Name the fear—what am I afraid of losing?—then test the thought by the Word and fruit. Breathe a simple prayer: Shepherd, lead me. Track hints for a week and watch clarity grow.
